about: A fold of one place is named by the points of that place, so finding it asks the readers only about the place: what they read elsewhere never enters its key.
Only a fold that was not kept observes the whole tree, and it keeps what it folded under the key it was asked by.
The pass, which observes once for every place, hands its observation to each fold and asks nothing twice.
